The story and game itself is absolutely incredible and I strongly suggest playing through it at some point in your life if you are into story based games, but my god does this port have problems. Yes it does look absolutely stunning and I congratulate the studio for making such a visually appearing piece, but if you can play it on a Playstation. The PC port is laggy, incredibly long load times, constant updates and re-installations of shaders even up till the end of my playthrough, and overall is a buggy mess when played on mouse and keyboard. Yes obviously this can all be changed in patches coming later down the line, but if I am paying above £50 for a new game, I expect it to be polished. 
TLDR: Incredible game, terrible port.

This review is as of The 25th of June 2023, on the 1.1.0 Patch.

My specs are pretty much equal to the recommended specs.

I have been able to complete the game from start to finish with no crashes or bugs, mostly high settings, 1440p dlss balanced. 
Most of the game holds 60 fps, but slows down to around 50 at very certain points.

Performance could be a bit better but it's not horrible, i think it's in a pretty acceptable state now.
It still has a ways to go though.

It's worth noting that this is one of the first ps5/new gen exclusive titles.
As always with a new generation of consoles, getting to that high/max settings at 60fps is going to get harder, it doesn't necessarily mean the optimization is horrible, but if you combine that with it being imperfect it does hurt.

I do still see some people saying the game is still unplayable for them, but i've also seen a few post specs below the specified minimum, so your mileage may vary.

TLDR: In my experience, if you stick to the minimum/recommended specs, you'll have decent performance if you use the appropriate settings.

[h1]  A Captivating Narrative Marred by Hardware Hiccups [/h1]

The highly anticipated arrival of The Last of Us on PC has finally become a reality, marking a significant moment for fans who have eagerly awaited this transition. However, the initial experience has been overshadowed by some unfortunate hardware issues, casting a shadow on an otherwise brilliant gaming saga.

Narrative Excellence:
Despite the rocky start, The Last of Us on PC retains its throne as a narrative masterpiece. The storytelling prowess and character arcs are unmatched, standing as a testament to the game's ability to draw players into a post-apocalyptic world filled with emotion, tension, and unforgettable moments. Naughty Dog has once again demonstrated why they are hailed for their storytelling capabilities, making The Last of Us a standout in the gaming industry.

Character Archetypes:
The character development in The Last of Us is nothing short of extraordinary. From Joel's complex journey to Ellie's resilience, players are treated to a cast that feels alive and authentic. The emotional depth of the characters adds a layer of immersion that few games can replicate. The Last of Us manages to create a genuine connection between players and the characters, making the overall experience truly memorable.

Hardware Woes:
Unfortunately, the joy of The Last of Us' arrival on PC is dampened by the presence of significant hardware issues. Players have reported various problems, from performance hiccups to compatibility issues with certain configurations. It's disheartening to see such a well-crafted game struggle on the technical front, and it leaves players longing for a smoother experience.

Hope for the Future:
Despite the initial setbacks, there's a glimmer of hope for the future. Fans speculate about the potential release of The Last of Us Part II on PC, and there's an optimistic wish that any installation woes would be ironed out. Naughty Dog has a track record of refining their games, and the hope is that the studio will address the hardware issues and deliver an enhanced experience for players.

Conclusion:
The Last of Us on PC is a mixed bag of emotions. On one hand, the narrative brilliance and character depth continue to shine, reaffirming the game's status as a modern classic. On the other hand, the disappointing hardware issues mar the overall experience. As fans eagerly await potential updates and improvements, one can't help but hope that The Last of Us Part II will make its way to PC with a smoother launch.

The Last of Us Part I - ремейк культовой игры, который решили выпустить не только на PS5, но и на PC. 
  Из плюсов: Выглядит ремейк шикарно – на уровне второй части,в окружении появилось больше деталей, модели главных героев и NPC стали заметно реалистичнее, сильно улучшили освещение: особенно это заметно в зданиях, где через окна или разбитые стены лучи проникают внутрь. Также появились новые анимации: Например, Джоэл теперь взводит курок, когда поднимает оружие – как Элли во второй части. Из сиквела также пришли подробные анимации улучшения оружия за верстаком, и многое другое, что сильно облагородило игру. Сюжет, все также цепляет и интересно следить за героями и повествованием. 
 Из минусов: Некоторые механики заметно устарели, мультиплеер вырезали. Цена игры. Ну и самое печальное это Оптимизация игры на старте, даже с течением 5 крупных патчей, когда я начал играть в игру, с топовым железом, игра нещадно грузит систему( в особенности Процессор, жутко долгая компиляция шейдеров и просто нереальный жор видеопамяти). 
  Рекомендовать первую часть можно лишь в нескольких случаях: если вы никогда не играли в нее раньше или хотите узнать с чего всё начиналось, чтобы пройти The Last of Us Part II.

This game is a survival horror masterpiece and has been lovingly remade (I last played it on PS3). The graphics and animation work in this title are absolutely incredible. 

I suppose the only question weighing on people's minds is whether this famously bad PC port on launch is now "playable". In my experience, I think so.

On a 4080 and 5800x @ ultra on 1440p UW , it absolutely is. I played with a 90fps frame cap and it was hitting or exceeding that most of the time.The latest patches have gone a long way towards smoothing out the experience for me. There are still dips when things get intense on screen but nothing to the level of me being completely taken out of the experience.  

Those who have medium-high-end hardware should be able to have a solid experience now - it's a shame the price of admission is so high for a game that everyone should play. Here's hoping Naughty Dog doesn't repeat this with future ports.

最早知道美末就是十年前，那个时候心里一直惦记着想玩这个游戏，可惜没有PS3。
现在，它登陆了PC平台。我花了数十个小时，通关多次，解锁所有附加内容，达成白金，看完纪录片，不得不感叹，TLOU真的是一部非常完美，优秀的电子游戏。（除了PC首发时极其糟糕的优化...）
画面表现力，人物塑造，人物关系发展的刻画，剧情，音乐都堪称顶级。搭配PS5手柄沉浸感极强。
游戏内设置选项很丰富，难度对大部分玩家来说没有问题，并且难度，资源，敌人等等可单独调节，完全不用担心。无论是想拿枪突突，还是潜行暗杀，每个玩家都能找到自己的玩法。
此外，目前版本的优化，若是想玩确实可以入手。

It's running pretty good for me. I've had a couple of crashes in 20 hours of play or so. I have a 3070ti, for what it's worth. 

The game itself is pretty stellar. The story slowly draws you in, and the characters are very compelling and well-acted/animated. 

I wasn't expecting stealth to be so effective, but actually this game really responds well to the stealth approach (in most areas). I love stealth games, so it's right up my alley in that way.

The weapons are a bit meh, but they get the job done. Traps and bombs are fun, when stealth isn't gonna cut it. The shotgun feels suitably powerful, and the bow is nicely done (yay, more stealth options). The sniper rifle is nice, but you hardly get to use it -- most stuff happens fairly close quarters. The various pistols and revolvers are good enough. 

Anyway, yeah, it's a good game. I'm having a lot of fun with it so far.
